perf.summary: Factor recurses on (d, n/d) recomputing n/d that PollardRho effectively already split; minor, but the MillerRabin/PollardRho calls dominate so leave structure, only ensure n/d computed once.
perf.currentCost: 'Factor(d,...); Factor(n / d,...)' computes n/d after the PollardRho call; this single division is negligible next to the probabilistic primality/factoring cost, so the file is essentially optimal.
perf.proposedChange: Optionally hoist 'long cof = n / d;' before the two recursive calls for readability/consistency with the single-division convention; no measurable perf change since the heavy lifting is in MillerRabin/PollardRho.
perf.rationale: Keeps the one-division-per-value convention and avoids any chance of recomputation, but the asymptotic and constant costs are governed by the number-theoretic subroutines, not this division.
perf.risk: None; identical behavior. Listed low-impact for completeness — Factorize is already well structured (insertion sort over the few prime factors is appropriate).
